digest.component_or_area: rebar CLI comment and positional-body commands
propositions: rebar comment accepts flag-like tokens (--body-file, --body) as the comment body instead of rejecting them, storing the flag string literally and discarding the intended content
the command exits with code 0 and produces no stderr even when the body is lost, making the failure undetectable until content is read later
the guard against flag misinterpretation as positional body must cover comment, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands and any other positional-only command
a user can escape the guard using -- (e.g. rebar comment <id> -- "-starts with dash") to store bodies that legitimately begin with -
an args[:min_args] slice compound bug simultaneously stores the flag AND discards surplus positionals holding the intended value
